shared_elements: bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
horizontal band across the lower field
justification: Both surfaces are grey stone worked in shallow relief and both show a bilaterally symmetric scheme in which a pair of round eye-like bosses sits above a central disc and a horizontal band, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat rectangular panel densely packed edge-to-edge with crisp, curling vegetal fronds and mask-like elements, while B is a massive free-standing block whose sparse, faint, angular incisions leave most of the eroded surface blank.
